publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Review-only scientific algorithmic anatomical or pathology reconstruction, not a photograph, scan, histology slide, patient record, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: NLM MeSH supplies controlled condition identity and scope; official NIH sources supply conservative anatomical and communication boundaries only. No source image or design is copied.

reviewStandard: Current controlled condition identity, conservative non-diagnostic anatomy or process orientation, non-stigmatizing communication, complete pale edge field, crop-safe geometry, and exact prompt frozen before exactly one generation call per cleared route. Every PNG was inspected at native 1536 by 1024 resolution; observed output controls later metadata.
promotionRule: Only the five exact accepted source hashes may be promoted to metadata-bearing lossless masters, article WebP derivatives, and centered contain-mode 1200x630 social WebP derivatives. The cropped Multiple Sclerosis source remains quarantined and non-public.

assets.scientificFinding: Migraine is a heterogeneous recurrent neurological condition. The selected brain, generic branching nerve, and artery models are neutral orientation only and do not identify an attack, aura, mechanism, subtype, or diagnosis.
assets.visualReview: Three complete separate teaching groups: one lateral brain with visible superficial vessels, one branching ivory-and-violet nerve-like model, and one patent layered artery segment. No person, symptom trope, lesion, label, clipping, signature, or watermark is visible.

outputAudit.reviewedBy: WikiBiome Control Tower native-resolution visual audit
outputAudit.observedSubjectDescription: Three complete groups: lateral brain with superficial vascular branches, branching ivory-and-violet nerve-like model, and patent layered artery segment.

assets.proposedAlt: Three migraine orientation models: an intact brain, a generic branching cranial sensory-nerve model, and an open artery segment.
assets.proposedCaption: Neutral neurovascular orientation for migraine. The three teaching models do not depict an attack, aura, visible lesion, or single established mechanism.
assets.proposedDescription: WikiBiome scientific reconstruction of three neutral neural and vascular teaching groups for migraine on a pale cool field; non-diagnostic and not a scan.
assets.proposedProvenance: Generated once from the immutable batch-053 prompt after MeSH and NINDS scope audit; human-audited at native resolution. Review-only trained-algorithmic reconstruction.

assets.scientificFinding: The prompt requested a neutral CNS and myelin orientation, but complete source geometry is a non-negotiable publication requirement.
assets.visualReview: Three intended groups are visible, but the enlarged myelinated axon is cut by the top, right, and bottom source edges. This source cannot support a complete-object article or social derivative.

outputAudit.reviewedBy: WikiBiome Control Tower native-resolution visual audit
outputAudit.observedSubjectDescription: Brain-and-spinal-cord model, spinal-cord cross-section, and a magnified myelinated axon whose upper and lower segments leave the source frame.
outputAudit.quarantineReason: The principal axon model is visibly severed at three source edges, violating the immutable complete-model and crop-safe requirements.

assets.scientificFinding: NEC primarily affects premature infants, but the generated anatomy has no verifiable age scale. It may be described only as generic intestinal orientation with one bounded non-graphic wall defect, never as diagnostic neonatal anatomy or a Bell stage.
assets.visualReview: Three complete groups: one generic small-and-large-intestine model, one layered wall cutaway with a broad smooth concavity, and one layered wall cutaway with a bounded irregular red-pink surface defect. No infant, perforation, blood, black tissue, label, clipping, signature, or watermark is visible.

outputAudit.reviewedBy: WikiBiome Control Tower native-resolution visual audit
outputAudit.observedSubjectDescription: Generic small-and-large-intestine orientation plus two complete layered wall models, one with a smooth concavity and one with a bounded irregular surface defect.
outputAudit.promptDeviation: The digestive orientation has no observable neonatal scale; metadata must not claim that age is visually established.

assets.proposedAlt: Generic intestinal orientation beside two layered wall models, one with a bounded non-graphic surface defect, for NEC education.
assets.proposedCaption: Representative intestinal and bounded wall-injury orientation for necrotizing enterocolitis. Scale does not establish neonatal age, and the models do not show perforation, diagnostic imaging, or disease stage.
assets.proposedDescription: WikiBiome scientific reconstruction of generic intestinal anatomy and two selected wall models for NEC orientation; non-graphic, non-diagnostic, and not literal histology.
assets.proposedProvenance: Generated once from the immutable batch-053 prompt after MeSH and NICHD scope audit; human-audited at native resolution. Review-only trained-algorithmic reconstruction.

assets.scientificFinding: NAFLD/MASLD involves excess fat in liver and spans states that must not be collapsed into steatohepatitis, fibrosis, or cirrhosis. The plate is limited to liver, lobule, and illustrative intracellular-lipid orientation.
assets.visualReview: Three complete groups: smooth intact liver with gallbladder, radial lobule-like teaching model, and a cluster of eight complete hepatocyte-like cells containing multiple pale droplets. No inflammation, fibrosis, cirrhosis, tumor, label, visible clipping, signature, or watermark is present.

outputAudit.reviewedBy: WikiBiome Control Tower native-resolution visual audit
outputAudit.observedSubjectDescription: Smooth liver, radial lobule-like teaching model, and eight-cell cluster with pale intracellular droplet forms.
outputAudit.promptDeviation: A few antialiased dark pixels reach the rightmost column, but the visible cell group retains pale margin and is complete.

assets.proposedAlt: Three fatty-liver orientation models: a smooth liver, a hepatic-lobule model, and eight hepatocyte-like cells with pale droplets.

assets.scientificFinding: Ovarian neoplasms span multiple tissues, histologies, and benign or malignant states. The plate uses reproductive orientation and one bounded nonspecific growth without claiming histologic subtype, origin, grade, stage, spread, or diagnosis.
assets.visualReview: Three complete groups: uterus with both tubes and ovaries, one isolated ovary cutaway with follicle-like structures, and a second isolated ovary cutaway bearing one prominent bounded irregular external growth. No spread, ascites, blood, label, clipping, signature, or watermark is visible.

outputAudit.observedSubjectDescription: Uterus with paired tubes and ovaries, one isolated follicle-bearing ovary cutaway, and one similar cutaway with a single prominent bounded irregular external growth.
